viewmodel._viewmodel_tuning_note: Standard entries apply from 5:4 through 16:9 and default to zero. Portrait and ultrawide entries are direct end values at portrait_aspect and ultrawide_aspect and blend from standard outside that range. fov_offset adjusts horizontal viewmodel field of view in degrees (4:3 reference); offset is [forward, left, up] Source units. Higher FOV offsets make the weapon smaller. Portrait defaults match the 97fac81 baseline; tune each profile directly without changing model scale.

weapon_rpg._portrait_tuning_note: Restored 97fac81 values: +16 degrees horizontal FOV and 4 Source units leftward, with the camera 16 units down. Adjust these direct values to tune how much of the launcher enters the portrait frame; do not scale the model.
